name: How long does a typical bathroom tile replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom tile replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom tile replacement project can vary significantly based on the size of the bathroom, the complexity of the tile pattern, and the extent of any necessary subfloor repairs. A small bathroom floor might take 2-4 days, while a larger bathroom involving both floor and shower walls could extend to 1-2 weeks. This timeframe includes preparation, old tile removal, subfloor inspection and repair, new tile installation, grouting, and sealing. Our team provides a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical bathroom tile replacement can take anywhere from a few days for a small floor to 1-2 weeks for a larger bathroom including walls, depending on project scope.
